scripts.build: python tools/export-theme.py --project intercargo && vite build --config projects/intercargo/vite.config.js
scripts.validate: python tools/validate-architecture.py && python themes/intercargo/tools/validate-theme.py && php themes/intercargo/tests/runtime-contract.php && node themes/intercargo/tests/editor-safety.mjs && python themes/intercargo/tests/visual-contract.py
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run validate && python tools/package-theme.py --project intercargo
